scope: Exploratory equal-update warm-start comparison, NOT equal compute or certification. Both arms start from identical 40000-step EMA weights with FRESH Adam; zero-initialized FiLM initially preserves the control function. Same training parents/windows/source/flow-time RNG per seed. No explicit Hamiltonian or new physical penalty. Full L25 short windows; three seeds retained; no early stopping, best-seed selection or automatic promotion.
evaluation: After all six train runs complete, compare both EMA arms and frozen original on the same development parents and paired latent seeds. First-window and full16000 rollout, two development initial families per temperature, 128 generated paths per family, 1024 sampling steps. Report magnetization distribution/diversity, spatial and temporal correlations and increments, endpoint/crossing counts, runtime, all seeds separately. Development is reused and not a fresh certification set; independent-reference diagnostics already inspected must not be relabeled final tests. Do not judge success from loss alone.
